# pvescheduler_placement_dynamic (Resource)

Selects and locks a Proxmox node for VM placement. The chosen node is stored in state and not re-evaluated on subsequent applies. Changing `exclude`, `zone`, `memory_weight` or `cpu_weight` replaces the resource and re-runs selection. Remove from state to force re-scheduling without a configuration change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# pvescheduler_placement_dynamic picks the least-loaded node, optionally
# restricted to one zone of the provider topology, and locks the result in
# state. Changing zone, exclude or a weight replaces the resource.
resource "pvescheduler_placement_dynamic" "placement" {
  # Must be a key of the provider topology (optional).
  zone = "par-a"

  # Exclude nodes that are reserved or under maintenance (optional).
  exclude = ["pve-storage-01"]

  # Tune scoring weights (defaults: memory_weight = 0.7, cpu_weight = 0.3).
  memory_weight = 0.7
  cpu_weight    = 0.3
}

# Spread replicas across zones, one placement per zone.
locals {
  zones = ["par-a", "par-b", "par-c"]
}

resource "pvescheduler_placement_dynamic" "replica" {
  count = length(local.zones)
  zone  = local.zones[count.index]
}

output "chosen_node" {
  value = pvescheduler_placement_dynamic.placement.node_name
}

output "replica_nodes" {
  value = pvescheduler_placement_dynamic.replica[*].node_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cpu_weight` (Number) Weight applied to CPU utilization when scoring nodes (default 0.3). Changing this forces a new placement.
- `exclude` (List of String) Node names to exclude from placement. Changing this forces a new placement.
- `memory_weight` (Number) Weight applied to memory utilization when scoring nodes (default 0.7). Changing this forces a new placement.
- `zone` (String) The selected availability zone to place the virtual machine. Zones need to be defined in topology of provider configuration. Changing this forces a new placement.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_usage_pct` (Number) CPU utilization of the selected node at time of placement, as a percentage (0-100).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `memory_usage_pct` (Number) Memory utilization of the selected node at time of placement, as a percentage (0-100).
- `node_name` (String) The selected Proxmox node name, locked in state after initial placement.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the PVE node name to pin this placement to. zone is not
# set on import, so importing into a config that sets zone plans a replacement.
terraform import pvescheduler_placement_dynamic.placement pve01
```
